title: Best habit tracker

author: kkwongcl

title: Useful
body:
Both to-do and count tracking are useful. The project mode is a bonus.
If a year view and overall view of all habits could be introduced, that would make this app more awesome!
A limit of 7 habits is a bit tight. I kept amending and deleting some of them.
author: TPYH

title: Best of the bunch
body:
Find this easy to use and most helpful of the to do / productivity / goal apps.
Love the ability to set "per week" goals rather than just specific dates.
